newsitem.title: ITALY: Minimum rate 6.27 pct at Italy lira repo tender.
newsitem.headline: Minimum rate 6.27 pct at Italy lira repo tender.

text.p: The minimum rate at Friday's 13.5 trillion lire 38-day Bank of Italy repurchase tender was 6.27 percent, compared with 6.85 percent at the previous repo tender on July 23, the Bank said.
The average rate was 6.58 percent against 6.87 percent at the last repurchase pact for 6.0 trillion lire and 27 days.
The pact covers purchases today and the securities are for resale on September 1. The Bank said it received 45 bids of which 41 were met in full and one in part.
